verdict.reasons: The image correctly displays the expected white-and-blue AFP drip tape roll with clear, authentic branding. The installed drip tape laterals are visible in the background and consistent with the product family. There is an appropriate, modest clearance between the product roll and the irrigation lines, and no core defects such as wrong products, fake logos, or geometric impossibilities were observed.

focused_physical_review.reason: 1. clear_soil_gap: The package footprint rests on an uninterrupted expanse of dry soil. 2. line_touches_or_crosses_package: The black irrigation lines run in parallel to the right of the package; no lines intersect the package's vertical axis, nor are any lines visible beneath it. 3. extra_loose_product_coil: Only the single required white-and-blue AFP package is present; no other uninstalled coils or rolls are visible. 4. package_has_protruding_strip: The sides and base of the package are clean, with no protruding white ribbon, strap, or tape tails emerging from the packaging.
